notes.note: Merge review (origin/main c2c67c2f25 #3155 and later, into #2947 at 7381866943): the merge took main's ledger record where both sides rebound it; #2947's earlier notes stay in notes files 20261001T191542.905Z-a4a5d81e2a67, 20261001T191606.497Z-c182111bbe01, 20261001T195534.905Z-fbeb93545158 and 20261003T062932.204Z-154e8d8dcfd8. claude-adapter.ts: #3155 adds disallowedTools for unselected MCP tools, additive toolServerMode (strictMcpConfig only for replacement), ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH from toolServerLoading, a filtered in-process station-control, and a PreToolUse block that denies an unselected or unknown MCP name before the staged evaluator. No prose change.
